body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adapts the `@objectstack/plugin-auth` to align with the new `sys_` prefix naming convention for system kernel objects (issue #738). The change bridges the gap between better-auth's hardcoded model names (`user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`) and ObjectStack's protocol-layer naming convention that requires `sys_` prefixes for system objects.

**Changes:**
- Introduced `AUTH_MODEL_TO_PROTOCOL` mapping and `resolveProtocolName()` function to translate better-auth model names to protocol names
- Updated all four auth object definitions to use `sys_` prefixed names
- Added comprehensive test coverage for the mapping layer and adapter operations
- Updated documentation (README, authentication.mdx, ROADMAP) to explain the adapter mapping pattern

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-user.object.ts | Updated object name from `user` to `sys_user` |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-session.object.ts | Updated object name from `session` to `sys_session` |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-account.object.ts | Updated object name from `account` to `sys_account` |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-verification.object.ts | Updated object name from `verification` to `sys_verification` |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts | Added `AUTH_MODEL_TO_PROTOCOL` mapping and `resolveProtocolName()` function; updated all 8 adapter operations to use the mapping |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.test.ts | Added 11 new tests covering mapping constants, resolver fallback, and adapter operations |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/README.md | Updated documentation to explain the model-to-protocol name mapping pattern |
| content/docs/guides/authentication.mdx | Updated guide with sys_ prefix convention and upgrade notes |
| ROADMAP.md | Added migration note about AUTH_MODEL_TO_PROTOCOL mapping requirement |
</details>

The test suite is missing coverage for `updateMany` and `deleteMany` adapter operations. While the implementation correctly uses `resolveProtocolName()` in both operations (lines 148 and 185 of objectql-adapter.ts), there are no tests to verify that these operations properly map model names to protocol names. Consider adding test cases similar to the existing ones for these two operations to ensure complete adapter coverage.
